title: Tendering Procedures and Bid Evaluation
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential knowledge, concepts, and skills required to manage tendering processes and bid evaluations effectively. Participants will gain an in-depth understanding of every step involved in tendering, from preparing tender documents to evaluating bids using diverse techniques and approaches. Through this interactive course, participants will learn to analyze submitted bids using key tools, including preliminary examination, technical evaluation, and commercial evaluation.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals involved in the initial stages of the contracting lifecycle who seek a thorough understanding of tendering processes, procedures, and evaluation techniques.
methodology: The course incorporates a mix of individual and group exercises to facilitate practical learning of key contract management activities. Case studies and participant presentations are followed by group discussions to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the concepts. Pre- and post-course assessments are included to measure learning progress.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the stages of contracting, from defining the scope of work to awarding the contract.
Understand the objectives of the tendering process and explore alternative contracting methods.
Develop a tendering strategy, determine the sourcing method, define the project scope of work, and plan the bidder evaluation process.
Gain expertise in preparing tenders and selecting potential contractors.
Apply advanced methodologies for preliminary, technical, and commercial evaluations using criteria, weights, and scoring systems to optimize bidder selection.
